verdict.rationale: SendGrid documents a first-email quickstart with sample code per language and official SDKs, plus a cURL getting-started guide, which covers the core 'copy-paste for my language' element. Nothing shows that the quickstart surfaces required prerequisites such as sender or domain authentication and API key creation. Nothing measures or corroborates the 'minutes from signup' claim. Missing for 10: evidence that the quickstart covers required setup (sender verification/domain auth, API key creation) inline, hands-on or independent confirmation of a minutes-to-first-delivery flow, and a complete runnable snippet beyond the setApiKey fragment.

support.subject: As a developer, I can go from signup to my first delivered email in minutes — the quickstart is copy-paste complete for my language and doesn't hide required setup

citations.quote: To send your first message, use the following sample code in your preferred programming language.
You can send your first email with the SendGrid API using cURL or one of the official SendGrid libraries.
These instructions describe how to send your first email using cURL calls.
